    markdown: "Coralogix action. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/coralogix-action-extension/."
applications  SetAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Applies the action for specific applications."
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator set must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtMostValidator set must contain at most 1000 elements
    validator: setvalidator.valueStringsAreValidator element value must satisfy all validations: string length must be between 0 and 1024

    markdown: "The user who created the action."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
description  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "Free-text description of the action. Removing this line clears the description."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthBetweenValidator string length must be between 0 and 65535
dpxl_filter  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "DPXL expression that scopes when the action is offered. The expression must include a version prefix, e.g. `<v1> $d.severity == 'ERROR'`. Removing this line clears the filter."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthBetweenValidator string length must be between 0 and 65535
    validator: stringvalidator.regexMatchesValidator must be empty or start with a version prefix, e.g. `<v1> $d.severity == 'ERROR'`
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "Action ID."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
is_hidden  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to false
    deprecated: "`is_hidden` is a per-user UI preference, not a property of the action. It will be removed in a future version."
    markdown: "Deprecated: `is_hidden` is a per-user UI preference, not a property of the action. It will be removed in a future version."
is_private  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to true
    markdown: "Determines weather the action will be shared with the entire team. Can be set to false only by admin."
name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Action name."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthBetweenValidator string length must be between 1 and 50
source_type  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "By selecting the data type, you can make sure that the action will be displayed only in the relevant context. Can be one of [\"DataMap\" \"Log\"]"
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["DataMap" "Log" "unspecified"]
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["DataMap" "Log"]

    markdown: "Applies the action for specific subsystems."
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator set must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtMostValidator set must contain at most 1000 elements
    validator: setvalidator.valueStringsAreValidator element value must satisfy all validations: string length must be between 0 and 1024
url  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "URL for the external tool."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthBetweenValidator string length must be between 1 and 32768
    validator: stringvalidator.regexMatchesValidator must start with http:// or https://
url_fields  ListNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Declarations for the `{{placeholder}}` slots in `url`, in the configured order."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtMostValidator list must contain at most 1000 elements
url_fields[]  NestedObject
url_fields[].name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "URL field name. Must be unique within `url_fields`."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthBetweenValidator string length must be between 1 and 1024

    markdown: "Whether the field must be present for the action to be invokable."
